items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: Not Arthur Godfrey, the other one.

ctx.x: That's wonderful that you all have that interest in you.

She has a boy to sing, Ave Maria, what age? Twelve, huh? Merlin? Merlin. Oh, he used to sing, when he was single, he sang a lot of weddings and church affairs. He used to do a lot of that. And he sang in some place in San Francisco, and they wanted to hire him immediately, but his wife didn't want it. He couldn't. And who was the man who wanted to take him away when he was 16? When he was 16. They wanted to take him to see this fellow who interviews. He had a show this summer called The Talent Show. Not Arthur…
Maybe another musician, famous musician, come out of the family sometimes.
